_README: The bag, asserted by hand. Nothing here is derived from the ledger — the
ledger only knows what was hit, and the point of this file is the clubs
that were not.
Keyed by the club's R50 `Club Type` string, which must appear in BAG_ORDER
in lib/clubs.ts. A key matching nothing there is reported as orphaned on
every run, the same as an exclusions.json typo.
CONTRACT — two tiers per club, on purpose:
brand, model, headType, shaft, grip
Owner-attested. Bare values, no source. You can read them off the club
or the receipt, and there is no page to cite that would make them more
true.
loftDeg  { value, source, confidence, checked, verified }
A claim, in the same shape as the map's data/facts.json, because loft
is the field that can be wrong. A driver has an adjustable sleeve, an
iron drifts a degree with bending and a wedge is ground to order, so
every number below is what the spec sheet says the club left the
factory as — not what a loft gauge has measured on THIS club.
verified stays false until somebody puts one on a machine.
POLICY, inherited from data/facts.json: unknown fields stay absent, never
guessed. A missing shaft renders as a gap; a wrong one is a lie the app
repeats forever. Deliberately absent right now: Vokey model, grind and
bounce; the Callaway UW's family (Apex vs Paradym); the KBS flex, which
the order line does not state; and the shafts and grips in the driver,
the UW and the three wedges.
STATUS: entered 2026-08-03. The eight iron lofts and the driver loft were
seeded from published specs and are ALL verified:false. The 19 on the UW
and the three wedge lofts are stamped on the clubs and owner-attested,
which is why they are high confidence and still unverified — nobody has
gauged them either.
THE UW IS KEYED "3 Hybrid". The R50's Club Type list has no utility-wood
entry, so a 19-degree Callaway UW logs in the rescue slot. The key is the
slot the monitor will record; brand and model say what the club actually
is. See DECISIONS.md.
The eight-iron order line is the receipt: 8 x P790, 8 x KBS S-Taper
Chrome, 8 x Tour Velvet 360. Three independent counts of the same eight
clubs, 3 iron through pitching wedge.

loftDeg.note: Head loft. The sleeve is adjustable +/-2 degrees and its current setting has never been checked, so the played loft is somewhere in 8.5-12.5.

3 Hybrid.note: A utility wood, not a hybrid. Keyed to the slot the R50 will log it in — see the _README.

Pitching Wedge.note: A set pitching wedge, not a Vokey. It is an iron head and is compared as one.
